## Shop strips — buttons and the note under every strip

*Every shop strip: under a chapter card's referral chip, between a path's reading list and its funding door, and after "How paying works" on the funding page (`chapter-shop.ts`; owner answer B21, 2026-10-06). Placements are on. A product is shown only while the store shows it, sells it and has it in stock, and never one whose description names or links another retailer. `add` adds one product in one click where there is nothing to choose; a product with a required option or modifier gets `chooseOptions`, a link to its page, instead. `addFor` and `chooseOptionsFor` are the buttons' accessible names. No kit is listed (A4).*

## Insulin and glucagon — the product page notice and the checkout’s Quebec line

*Outside the Diabetes Care pages, on the store’s own pages. Read on the server and passed down, so the browser’s message bundle does not change. `pharmacistNotice` sits under the buy box of every insulin and glucagon product page, and `insulinColdChain` and `quebecInsulin` under it on insulin only (glucagon, Baqsimi, is kept at room temperature, so cold-chain is said of insulin alone, since the full-site review of 2026-10-06; insulin is category 1116 plus Trurapi 4719 and 5002; glucagon is Baqsimi 4555: `dc-ids.ts`). The same two lines print under the shop strips that need them (`notices` in chapter-shop.ts): `pharmacistNotice` under Staying Safe card 3’s glucagon strip, and all three under New to the Journey card 8’s link to the insulin shelf, on English pages only, once that link is shown again (`INSULIN_SHELF.linked`, held since 2026-10-06 while products on the shelf carry another retailer’s link or name; B3). `quebecInsulinCheckout` shows in the checkout’s payment section, under a pay button that stays off, when the cart has insulin and the shipping province is Quebec; `{phone}` is `contact.phone`. The server also refuses that order (`buildCheckoutSnapshot`). Rests on the owner’s answers of 2026-10-06 (A1, A8, B3, B11, B29) and `bep-about` for the phone. Not behind a French review gate: on /fr the French draft shows, as a notice, not an offer. Subscription renewals to Quebec are not checked (operations, OPEN-QUESTIONS B11).*

- `commerce.pharmacistNotice` — Un pharmacien vérifie et prépare chaque commande d’insuline et de glucagon, expédiée dans un emballage neutre. ⚑
- `commerce.insulinColdChain` — L’insuline est expédiée sous chaîne du froid. ⚑
- `commerce.quebecInsulin` — L’insuline ne peut pas être commandée en ligne pour une livraison au Québec. ⚑
- `commerce.quebecInsulinCheckout` — L’insuline ne peut pas être commandée en ligne pour une livraison au Québec. Retirez-la pour continuer, ou appelez la Pharmacie Bayshore Express au {phone} et un pharmacien vous aidera. ⚑
